html: I’m excited to announce that Prophecy’s Daughter, Book 2 of The Endarian Prophecy will be released on Jan 16th, 2018.

comments.author: Kandyce Russell
comments.html: I just finished your first book, Mark of Fire, and I LOVED it! I got to read it through Kindle First and I can’t wait for your second book to come out. I’ve already pre-ordered it. January can’t come fast enough.

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html:
Thanks Kandyce. Glad you are enjoying the tale.
Best,
Richard

comments.author: Roger W Price
comments.html: When can we expect Book 4 in the Endarian Prophecy? I just finished Curse of the Chosen and can’t wait

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html:
Hi Roger. I am hard at work on Book 4 now and will be finished with the draft by October. My publisher has not yet determined a release date but I will post it here as soon as I know.
Richard

comments.author: Joel
comments.html: Will Book 4 be the conclusion of the Endarian Prophecy series?

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html:
Hi Joel. Actually, The Endarian Prophecy series will conclude in book six. After that, I plan on following up on a follow up to my Rho Agenda series.
Best,
Richard
